genre: story/hustle montage over a voiceover spine
identity: A narration (the creator's own, or iconic movie audio) drives a specific sequence of footage that illustrates, proves or productively contrasts each important thought. Shot length, caption density, grade and ending respond to the material: raw authenticity, patient cinema and fast art direction are all valid when they form one coherent world.

movie-audio-bw.notes: Wolf of Wall Street audio; FULL monochrome; single-word center captions; 72 flash frames (whips)

lifestyle-money.notes: creator narration; giant airbrushed money words ($500,000, TOP 1%); Stripe-style revenue-proof cards; scattered small-caps captions

raw-startup-vlog.notes: handheld phone clips, plain white bottom-third phrase captions, zero decoration — authenticity IS the style

designed-travel.notes: poster-grade full-frame type cards (red/black), animated flight-path maps, social-UI comment props between b-roll

rules.clip_selection: each chosen clip has a named relationship to the narration—literal evidence, useful metaphor, emotional counterpoint or continuity bridge. It enters when that relationship becomes legible and holds long enough to read; it may span phrases or cut quickly according to information and motion
rules.captions: caption density and placement follow comprehension and the chosen visual skin. Designed phrase text arrives at the spoken thought; documentary lines, sparse keywords or no captions can each be right
rules.display_moments: reserve full-frame or oversized display treatment for the few phrases whose narrative weight earns a register change; zero is valid when footage and voice already carry the peak
rules.proof_props: money/social skins insert UI evidence (revenue cards, comment threads, profile mockups) timed to the claims
rules.grade: preserve truthful product, skin and environment color unless a coherent story world earns stylization; monochrome, muted, vivid and raw are choices rather than defaults
rules.ending: resolve, reframe or deliberately leave the narration's tension in a final image; use a CTA only when the brief has one

capability_notes: Selection needs the caption-phrase -> footage-moment match, which is exactly what a sighted index provides (shot captions + transcript). Display money-words and poster cards = add_text templates; revenue-proof/comment props are a graphics-pack gap (same gap as talking-head-promo's ui_mockups).
